_rationale: Each line sits roughly half-way (in ratio terms) between the largest harmless noise measured (6 noise sources) and the mildest bad change (rope_theta 0.5x), using bootstrap interval ends. Chosen Day 12: flip rate 3.5% (noise max 2.06%, upper end 2.26%; mild rope lower end 4.68%), mean KL 0.004 (noise max 0.00105; mild rope lower end 0.00791), perplexity change +0.2% (noise upper end +0.084; mild rope lower end +0.37). Gate fails when at least 2 of 3 metrics fail.
